## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

S6.3a landed the multi-family code-search + hosted-coordinate surface.
`hh-eval::critic_experiment` already carried the {`critic_off`,
`critic_on`} arms + five-metric matched comparison + removal-test
handle; `hh-verification` already enforced critic-side held-out
boundaries; `hh-ledger` already registered the
`measurement.evolution.*` classes. What did not exist: the M2–M5
attribution design/report machinery (`hh-attribution-design/1`,
`hh-attribution/1`), the counterfactual arm under `noise_coupling =
crn`, `locus`, `estimate_rollouts`, the `attribution_ref`
hypothesis→design link, `TargetMismatch`, the label gate at S5, the
judge/monitor selector legs (`held_out_from`,
`JudgeLeakedIntoArtifact`, monitor assignment→veto), the
critic-experiment→value-of-compute row fold, and the lineage DAG +
`attribute_lineage`.

| AC/leg | Landed | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `hh-attribution-design/1` + `hh-attribution/1` | `DESIGN_SCHEMA`/`REPORT_SCHEMA` codecs (content-derived ids), closed `ATTRIBUTION_METHODS` {M1…M5} + `ATTRIBUTION_LABELS` {`designed_ablation` < `causal_interventional` < `causal_coupled`} + `LABEL_METHOD_FLOORS` (M1 → `designed_ablation`; M2/M4/M5 → `causal_interventional`; M3 → `causal_coupled`) — a `causal_coupled` design under M1/2/4/5 refuses at validate (KA-I7-6) | `crates/hh-analysis/src/attribution.rs` |
| V-checks + `estimate_rollouts` | V1 method set · V2 targets·estimand · V3 coupling ∈ {`none`,`crn`} · V4 budget reservation · V5 `estimate_rollouts` power (a design that cannot satisfy its `attribution_label` → `UnderpoweredDesign`, KA-I7-5) · V6 declared `noise_coupling = crn` ⇒ assumptions record it (`noise_coupled_crn` member) | `crates/hh-analysis/src/attribution.rs` |
| `plan` + `attribute` (M2–M5) | `attribution_plan` resolves the factual arm + counterfactual forks (`replay`, `toggle_locus`, `ablate_locus`, `resample_exogenous`, `mediate`) per (target, fork-point); `attribution_attribute` executes, emits `effects[]` per (target, fork-point) (`effect_kind` ∈ {`paired_te`, `counterfactual_te`, `crn_te`, `de`, `ie`, `shapley`} + `uncertainty_ppm`), folds `rollouts_run`/`budget_spent`/`truncated`/`assumptions`/`uncoupled_sources`/`authority_widening_refusals`, assigns the `attribution_label` ceiling (confirmatory ⇒ designed floor, degraded ⇒ downgraded) and mints the deterministic `report_id` | `crates/hh-analysis/src/attribution.rs` |

| `attribution_quality` (KA-I7-9/11) | `uncoupled_share`/`label`/`label_ceiling`/`truncated`/`multiplicity`/`authority_widening_refusals` folded into one quality row; `unattributed_share` the residual | `crates/hh-analysis/src/attribution.rs` |

| Lineage DAG + attribution over it (R-2.12.1⁴) | `hh_evolution::lineage` — `LineageNode`/`LineageEdge`/`LineageDag` folded from the view's candidate records (rejected candidates stay nodes); parent edge = `base_ref` → the earlier-registered candidate whose `target_ref` it equals (the campaign base is the root); `attribute_lineage` composes the deposited reports — per-node `edge_effect` (signed sum of `effects[].point`), `edge_share_ppm` over the lineage-wide |effect| mass, `reported = false` for nodes without a report | `crates/hh-evolution/src/lineage.rs` |

## Decisions

See **ADR-0324** — the claim-level `attribution_ref` gate (D1);
veto-only deterministic-first monitors (D2); the declared held-out
closure + `JudgeLeakedIntoArtifact` (D3); the S5 design-bound label
gate (D4); the `PlacementFact`-verbatim value-of-compute row (D5);
base↔target parent edges + edge-share attribution (D6); M2's
per-(target, fork-point) effects + CRN at the exogenous draw (D7);
the label ceiling as admissibility floor (D8).

## In-run fixes worth recording

- **`records.rs` field surface** — `SelectorDeclaration` gained
  `kind`/`adversarial`/`held_out_from` and `JudgePolicy` gained
  `artifact_benefit_selector`; `FailureHypothesis` gained
  `attribution_ref`. Every landed struct literal + the strict JSON
  codecs + `check_audit_partition` needed the new members; caught by
  `cargo check` (E0063/missing-member refusals) and threaded through
  the three landed test batteries.
- **`hypothesize` delimiter repair** — a mid-run edit left the
  hypothesis-document `Json::obj` block unbalanced; rewritten as an
  iterator chain conditionally appending `attribution_ref`
  (unclosed-delimiter error, `cargo check`).
- **`Transition` member discipline** — monitor assignment detection
  initially read `t.extra`; `Transition` has no such member — the
  assignment/veto check now rides the folded view's persisted fields.
- **`held_out_eval` signature** — grew the attribution/judge legs;
  every caller (`hh-embed/src/evolution_ops.rs` +
  `s6_1a`/`s6_2`/`s6_3a` test fixtures) updated to pass retention,
  veto maps, attribution report refs, and the locality-claim flag.
- **Deferred-row disposition** — DF-S1.15-1 / DF-S1.22-1 /
  DF-S1.24-1 gained dated progress notes (monitor.* classes +
  `attribution_ref` field surface; the selector/judge-integrity
  halves; the estimator-kernel halves); DF-S1.14-4 unchanged — no
  exporter leg landed.
- **`crates/hh-eval/tests` member churn** — `MetricReport` gained a
  `declared` leg (undeclared metrics → `UndeclaredMetricDropped`,
  never silently dropped); ~45 literals got `declared: true`.
